summary: Tested SearchSuggestions and ProductPlaceholder components on Pharmacy (/pharmacy) and Nutricare (/nutricare) pages. All 14 features verified working correctly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: SearchSuggestions and ProductPlaceholder components verified working. SearchSuggestions shows trending/recent searches when search input is focused AND empty. Recent searches persist in localStorage under key 'nc_recent_searches'. Clear All button removes recent searches. Pharmacy trending items: Paracetamol, Dolo 650, Azithromycin, Amoxicillin, Crocin, Pan D, Shelcal, Limcee, Cetirizine, Allegra. Nutricare/HealthPlus trending items: Blood Pressure Monitor, Glucometer, Pulse Oximeter, Thermometer, Protein Powder, Multivitamin, Nebulizer, Weighing Scale. ProductPlaceholder renders form-specific SVG icons for products without images. Sticky cart bar appears when items in cart.

2_trending_items_displayed.details: 11 trending items displayed (10 items + header). Items: Paracetamol, Dolo 650, Azithromycin, Amoxicillin, Crocin, Pan D, Shelcal, Limcee, Cetirizine, Allegra

9_healthplus_trending_items.details: 9 trending items displayed. Items: Blood Pressure Monitor, Glucometer, Pulse Oximeter, Thermometer, Protein Powder, Multivitamin, Nebulizer, Weighing Scale

10_clicking_trending_fills_search.details: Clicking trending item fills search bar and closes suggestions

11_renders_for_products_without_images.details: ProductPlaceholder SVG icons render for products without images in Trending Now section

12_form_specific_colors.details: ProductPlaceholder uses form-specific colors: tablet=blue, capsule=purple, syrup=amber, drops=cyan, cream=pink, injection=red, device=teal

13_search_results_dropdown.details: Search results dropdown appears when typing, shows 15 results for 'Paracetamol'

14_discount_badges.details: 40 discount badges (15% OFF, 10% OFF) displayed on medicine cards

15_sticky_cart_bar.details: Sticky cart bar appears at bottom when items in cart, shows item count + total + View Cart button
